Term1: Immunization of patients with chronic liver disease
Text:
# IMMUNIZATION OF PATIENTS WITH CHRONIC LIVER DISEASE

See specific immunization information pages located at the bottom of this page
for other indications, contraindications, and one-time dose orders to listed
vaccines.

Patient vaccine history

CDC Recommended Adult Immunization Schedule

# Specific vaccine orders for patients with chronic liver disease:

[Haemophilus influenza type b: indicated in asplenia, those undergoing](haemophilus-influenza-type-b-vaccine-information)
splenectomy and HSCT patients. Refer to specific immunization recommendations
for patients with these indications or refer to the Haemophilus influenza type b
vaccine information menu below.

Hepatitis A: 2 dose series.

Hepatitis A/B: 3 dose series.

Hepatitis B: 2 dose Heplisav-B series

Herpes zoster: 2 dose series in those age >/= 50yrs.

Human papillomavirus: 3 dose series through age </= 26yrs and for age 27-45yrs
based on shared clinical decision making.

[Influenza: one dose annually.](flu-seasonal-influenza)

Measles, mumps, and rubella: one dose.

Measles, mumps, and rubella: 2 dose series, for those w/additional risk factor
or another indication.

[Meningococcal A, C, W and Y: indicated in asplenia, HIV, complement deficiency](meningococcal-conjugate-vaccine-information)
or inhibitor use, travel to endemic countries, microbiologists, and college
students. Refer to specific immunization recommendations for asplenia and HIV or
refer to the Meningococcal A, C, W and Y vaccine information menu below.

Meningococcal B: 2 dose series, for those w/additional risk factor or another
indication.

Pneumococcal 20-valent: one dose, administer via clinical reminder.

Tetanus, diphtheria and pertussis: 3 dose primary series, booster every 10yrs.

Varicella: 2 dose series.
